title: q-centred diffusion and a smaller time step on the bumps
reason: LISFLOOD-FP's ACC solver drops the advection term of the momentum equation, so flow over a bump, where the velocity changes along the channel, is outside what it is built for; the developers point to FV1 or DG2 for such flow. Within ACC, the q-centred weighting theta = 0.7 (de Almeida et al., 2012; the default 1 adds no diffusion) damps the oscillations that grow over the crest, and a Courant number of 0.3 instead of 0.7 keeps the step small where the flow speeds up. The error falls by roughly 40 % on all three bumps; it does not reach the accuracy band, because the missing term is structural.
